correctness.rationale: Reflection about −1/2 turns the second cubic sum into δU, where δ=χ(−1). Substitution −x/(x+1) on the field minus −1 turns the quartic sum into δU−1, with the missing cubic summand δ at −1 accounting for the constant. In the sign-indicator expansion the two separable monic quadratic sums are −1. The zero terms at 0 and −1 are (1+b)(1+c) and (1+aδ)(1+c); at each cyclotomic root ρ the first two characters are 1 and δ because ρ=(ρ²)² and ρ+1=−ρ². Subtracting these terms gives the piecewise formulas with the stated singleton sign pair for each δ. The curve has q+1+U points and is smooth in the intended odd characteristics other than 3. Hasse yields simultaneous positivity by q≥71 (even the weakest lower bound q−19−6√q is positive and increasing there). Below 71 the 17 eligible primes and 25,49 exhaust the admissible orders. A fresh field enumeration verified all counts there and the exact exception list. In particular the bins at 49 in lexicographic order with + before − are (9,0,4,8,4,8,4,8); 41,43,47 and 53 have no missing bin. The stated cutoffs are the least eligible field orders after the last failure in their respective classes. Characteristic 3 is separate: the quadratic becomes (x−1)² and has no negative sign.
residual_risks: The replay certifies the finite remainder, not the infinite Hasse argument; no histogram is claimed in characteristic 3.
